RESEARCH_BOUNDARY: External research only; no target repository analysed.
FROZEN_SYNTHESIS: A conditional socio-technical control-and-learning architecture that defines constrained outcomes; exposes end-to-end state, queues and abnormalities; controls commitments and batch economics where useful; chooses variability buffers; builds quality and bounded escalation/recovery into work; maintains revisable and retireable baselines; qualifies countermeasures with evidence; develops worker and supplier capability without coercive risk transfer; preserves options under uncertainty; and couples speed to reliability, resilience and recovery.

BURDEN_CLOSURE.FINDING: Toyota documents TWI's US origin and 1950 Ministry-of-Labour introduction. Participant testimony supports selective uptake: Job Instruction remained important; Job Methods was judged insufficient and replaced/adapted; Job Relations was broadened. This is supervisor-training ancestry, not proof that TWI authored TPS.

Toyota introduced SQC in 1949, developed control-chart and recurrence-control practice, institutionalised TQC from 1961 and won the Deming Application Prize in 1965. The defensible lineage is to variation visibility, process capability, iterative study and company-wide quality—not to JIT, kanban or jidoka.

Primary TPS sources describe participation and signalling, but empirical evidence shows participation/autonomy can decline. Final properties split signal authority, local change, team change, cross-functional change and system-owner authority; no blanket empowerment claim survives.

Toyota's 1950 conflict and 1962 compact show that stability/trust were institutional, historically contingent issues. Security and fair distribution are strongest where workers are expected to expose labour-saving ideas; they are not universal guarantees of Lean.

BURDEN_CLOSURE.BURDEN: Supplier development versus supplier risk transfer
BURDEN_CLOSURE.FINDING: Supplier knowledge sharing and capability development are retained separately from multi-tier resilience. Universal synchronisation, concentration and buyer-imposed buffer removal are rejected because disruption and labour/cost can be transferred downstream.

Pull is an explicit WIP bound, not a card; variability is absorbed through inventory, capacity or time, supplemented in practice by information, redundancy and scope/recovery options. Inventory minimum is replaced by governed buffer-portfolio economics.

BURDEN_CLOSURE.BURDEN: Takt and levelling under high variability
BURDEN_CLOSURE.FINDING: Classic takt/heijunka remains useful for repetitive measurable demand with controllable mix and setup. High-mix/low-volume conditions need grouping, workload control, dynamic scheduling and explicit residual-variation buffers; no general knowledge-work takt survives.

BURDEN_CLOSURE.BURDEN: Jidoka/stop authority under false alarms and throughput pressure
BURDEN_CLOSURE.FINDING: Final model separates define, detect, signal, triage, contain/stop, restore, diagnose, countermeasure, qualify/restart and recurrence learning. Stop scope depends on consequence, detector quality, response capability and safe authority; the physical cord and unconditional global stop are rejected.

BURDEN_CLOSURE.BURDEN: Standard-work change authority, expiry and retirement
BURDEN_CLOSURE.FINDING: Historical standardised work supports explicit takt/sequence/standard-WIP baselines. Mature form adds version, purpose, exceptions, change authority, qualification, freshness review, expiry and retirement. The latter are evolved governance safeguards rather than claims about universal historical Toyota practice.

Kaizen outcomes depend on leadership, ownership and sustainment; Five Whys can produce shallow arbitrary roots; PDSA is often used without iterative tests, predictions or time-series evidence. Evidence-bound hypotheses and qualified countermeasures survive; formats/counts do not.

Software Kanban evidence reports lead-time/coordination benefits but is early and case-heavy. DORA/SPACE-style measures are diagnostic system signals, not value or individual productivity truth; balanced outcomes, definition stability and anti-gaming checks are required.

BURDEN_CLOSURE.BURDEN: Outcome evidence beyond local process improvement
BURDEN_CLOSURE.FINDING: Manufacturing meta-analysis supports average performance benefit with heterogeneity. Healthcare reviews find process/flow gains more often than patient, worker or financial gains. Local cycle-time or waste reduction is not accepted as end-outcome proof.

Cross-functional integration and reusable trade-off knowledge are retained. Set-based option preservation is triggered by uncertainty, coupling and costly irreversibility; its comparative empirical support is materially weaker than its conceptual/case literature.

Lean software is a practitioner translation; software Kanban abstracts visualisation and WIP control; Continuous Delivery/DevOps independently add automation, observability, reliability and recovery. No physical board or direct full-TPS ancestry is presumed.

Neither stockpiling nor JIT guarantees resilience. Mature form segments dependencies and chooses viable stock, capacity, alternate-source, regionalisation, information and recovery options according to criticality, lead time and turbulence.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Toyoda power loom automatically stops when weft breaks or runs out.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Early abnormality detection, defect prevention and separation of routine machine operation from constant human watching.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Kiichiro Toyoda articulates making only what is needed without shortage or excess and seeks flow at the Koromo plant.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Documented JIT intent precedes the later supermarket/kanban implementation.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Wartime rationing and supply constraints disrupt exact-time/quantity production.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: JIT is historically contingent on supply and information conditions, not a context-free zero-inventory rule.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Toyota experiments with pull, visual signals, multi-machine tending, takt/sequence/standard-WIP standardised work and early andon.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: TPS components assemble incrementally; no single tool or inventor constitutes the system.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Toyota introduces statistical quality-control study and control charts.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Variation and recurrence control are a shared quality ancestry that develops alongside JIT.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: TWI reaches Japan through the Ministry of Labour; Toyota adopts supervisor training modules.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Selective transmission is documented: Job Instruction persisted, while Job Methods and Job Relations were adapted or replaced; TWI did not author TPS as a whole.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Toyota's severe financial and labour dispute includes proposed job reductions and Kiichiro's resignation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Employment security and trust cannot be presumed from later respect-for-people doctrine.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Toyota studies Ford operations and bases its suggestion system on Ford's example.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Ford is both a benchmark and a documented source; Toyota selected and transformed rather than simply rejected mass production.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Toyota implements downstream withdrawal/replenishment after an industry article on a Lockheed 'supermarket method'; kanban becomes an instruction signal.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Corrects the personal-supermarket-visit myth and distinguishes pull property from card implementation.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Shigeo Shingo teaches production-analysis P-Course material to Toyota personnel.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Material training/industrial-engineering contribution; broad claims that Shingo invented JIT, jidoka, kanban or TPS remain unsupported.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Toyota formalises company-wide TQC and receives the Deming Application Prize in 1965.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Quality-system and participation infrastructure is strengthened; this is not evidence that Deming originated JIT or jidoka.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Toyota and its union sign a declaration linking mutual trust, productivity, working conditions and employment stability.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: A labour compact supported the production system but remained an institutional commitment whose practice must be tested empirically.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Kanban expands across plants and suppliers; levelling, maintenance, supplier quality and visible supervisory response develop.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Pull becomes a networked capability dependent on reliability, setup reduction, information and supplier conditions.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Fixed-position stopping, sub-ten-minute setup, broader standardised work and in-process quality measures are recorded.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Small lots and stop authority were engineered with response windows, buffers and setup economics—not applied as absolutes.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Sugimori, Kusunoki, Cho and Uchikawa publish an English TPS account.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Contemporary primary source identifies JIT/minimum stock and a respect-for-human participation system; doctrine is not outcome proof.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Ohno publishes Toyota Production System: Beyond Large-Scale Production.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Central participant codification, retrospective and author-centred rather than complete institutional history.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: John Krafcik publishes 'Triumph of the Lean Production System.'
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: 'Lean' emerges as an external comparative analytical category, not Toyota's original name for TPS.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: The Machine That Changed the World popularises the IMVP craft/mass/Lean comparison.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Lean becomes a global transformation narrative with stronger transferability claims than the Toyota-specific historical record warrants.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Automotive product-development research identifies integration, heavyweight leadership and set-based concurrent engineering.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: A distinct product-development lineage preserves alternatives under uncertainty rather than eliminating apparent redundancy immediately.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Economic, labour and health critiques challenge universal superiority and empowerment claims.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Actual Lean effects are contested; tool-copying is not the only source of harm.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Lean Thinking generalises value, value stream, flow, pull and perfection beyond automotive manufacturing.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Conceptual portability increases while Toyota-specific labour, maintenance, supplier and governance institutions recede.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Learning-system, socio-technical, contingency and construct-definition interpretations mature.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Lean shifts from visible tools toward hypotheses, connections, culture and bundles, while definitional ambiguity remains.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Toyota formalises Continuous Improvement and Respect for People in Toyota Way 2001.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Later doctrine strengthens social constraints but does not retroactively establish worker experience.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Lean software, software Kanban and Continuous Delivery translate or converge on WIP, small-batch feedback and automation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Physical cards and factory routing are not required; quality, architecture, observability and recovery become decisive software conditions.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Hopp and Spearman define tactical pull by an explicit WIP limit and Lean by the cost of buffering variability.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Operations science replaces inventory ideology with explicit inventory/capacity/time buffer economics.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Longitudinal and review evidence documents both positive participatory cases and autonomy loss, work intensification and stress.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Worker authority, support, security and work design are causal conditions, not automatic consequences of Lean.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Inventory-performance and disruption research qualify extreme leanness; Toyota maps deeper tiers and later literature advocates JIT/JIC segmentation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Strategic buffers, multi-tier visibility and recovery capability become legitimate evolved properties.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: PDSA, Five Whys and root-cause-analysis research exposes low-fidelity iteration and shallow single-cause narratives.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Prediction-bearing tests and qualified countermeasures survive; exact templates and counts do not.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Healthcare reviews report frequent flow gains but weak or mixed patient, worker and financial outcomes.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: Local process improvement cannot stand in for system or beneficiary outcome evidence.

EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.EVENT: Modern software delivery research combines flow with stability, observability, reliability, recovery and multidimensional productivity safeguards.
EVOLVED_LEAN_TIMELINE.SIGNIFICANCE: The mature software hybrid rejects speed-only or single-metric Lean translation.

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Outcome and value definition with named beneficiary, constraints and time horizon
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Toyota's customer-first quality doctrine; Lean Thinking's value principle; later service/product critiques.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Define value from the customer and orient production toward it.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Organisations can efficiently produce outputs that do not improve the beneficiary's outcome or that externalise cost.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Efficient delivery of low-value, harmful or locally beneficial work.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Name the beneficiary and desired outcome; state safety, labour, resilience and externality constraints; choose a time horizon; test whether work changes the outcome.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Multiple plausible outputs compete, resources are material, or local efficiency could displace customer/system value.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For trivial, reversible work, record a one-sentence purpose and acceptance condition rather than create a value-stream artefact.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Legitimate beneficiary representation; outcome observability; explicit non-negotiable constraints; authority to stop low-value work.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Better selection, fewer abandoned outputs, reduced proxy optimisation and clearer trade-offs.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Customer rhetoric masks managerial cost goals; one stakeholder's value harms another; short-horizon metrics; unmeasurable outcomes; retrospective rationalisation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Lean literature specifies waste more richly than value; customer language can ignore workers, suppliers, public risk and long-term resilience.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Moved from production value and waste categories toward multi-stakeholder outcome framing, product discovery and system constraints.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use an explicit value hypothesis with beneficiary, outcome, constraints, evidence threshold, review date and abandonment rule.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: No Lean vocabulary, value workshop or value-stream map is required; the property is a decision-relevant outcome model.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should value be aggregated when customers, workers, suppliers and public safety conflict?
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target system name the beneficiary, desired outcome, constraints and time horizon rather than equating output or waste removal with value?
Can it stop or retire work when the value hypothesis fails?
Are labour, safety, resilience and external costs prevented from disappearing behind a customer-value claim?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: End-to-end system boundary and flow/queue/handoff visibility
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: TPS material/information flow; Lean value-stream generalisation; later service/software translations.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: See the whole path from demand through production and delivery rather than optimise isolated machines or departments.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Local gains create downstream queues, rework, handoff loss or delayed customer outcomes.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Local optimisation and invisible waiting across organisational boundaries.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Define the relevant path and work classes; observe arrivals, queues, processing, rework, handoffs, dependencies and outcome latency; assign end-to-end ownership.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Repeated handoffs, unexplained elapsed time, departmental optimisation or customer delay dominate processing time.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a short single-owner path, a simple trace or sampled timeline is enough; no wall-sized map.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Stable item identity; traceability across boundaries; truthful timestamps/states; an owner able to resolve cross-boundary causes.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduced total lead time, fewer handoff failures, better bottleneck and queue decisions.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Map theatre; stale diagrams; excessive instrumentation; forced linear path for exploratory work; omission of externalities; local teams unable to change system constraints.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Value-stream maps are frequently local snapshots and can mistake visible factory-like sequence for the real distributed causal system.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Value-stream mapping was generalised beyond factories; modern software combines traces and delivery telemetry, while discovery work may require networks rather than linear streams.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Maintain the cheapest decision-useful end-to-end model, including feedback/rework loops, queues, dependencies and outcome—not just touch time.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A value-stream map is one implementation. Event logs, service blueprints, dependency graphs or sampled traces may be stronger.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should boundaries be chosen in multi-product, platform or ecosystem settings without creating an unmanageable total map?
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: End-to-end latency, queue and handoff profile; assumes valid item identity and boundary. Over-instrumentation and forced linearisation are failure modes.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system expose end-to-end waiting, queues, handoffs, rework and outcome latency rather than only local activity?
Is the map or trace current enough to change a decision?
Does it preserve a cheap path where the work is already short, observable and single-owner?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Workplace and work-state legibility
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: TPS visual control/5S/andon; later service and software visualisation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Arrange physical work so expected state, ownership, missing items and abnormalities are easy to discern.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Search, ambiguity and hidden state delay action or conceal abnormal work.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Undetected abnormality, lost work, excessive search and ambiguous ownership.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Expose state and limits at the point of work using labels, layout, telemetry, state models or visual cues proportional to decision need.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Work is repeatedly lost, searched for, misrouted, duplicated or left in an ambiguous state.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: When state is already obvious and low-risk, use naming conventions or a small status field; do not create ritual boards or audit scoring.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Shared state definitions; maintenance ownership; accessibility; protection against surveillance and stale displays.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Faster recognition, lower search/coordination cost, earlier abnormality detection.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: 5S audit theatre; cosmetic tidiness; information overload; stale boards; worker surveillance; local legibility hiding end-to-end state.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Evidence for exact 5S bundles is small and heterogeneous; legibility can become discipline and scoring rather than aid.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Expanded from physical workplace order to digital work-state and observability; mature form separates human legibility from metric control.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Make the minimum relevant normal/abnormal state visible to people who can act, with freshness, accessibility and ownership controls.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: 5S labels, shadow boards and kanban columns are optional; cleanliness scores are not the property.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How much legibility improves outcomes independently of accompanying management attention remains weakly identified.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Can responsible people tell the current and abnormal state without reconstructing it manually?
Are displays fresh, action-linked and non-punitive rather than ceremonial surveillance?
Would additional visual management solve a real ambiguity or merely add another board?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Conditional pull/release control and explicit WIP limits
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Toyota supermarket/kanban; operations-science formalisation; software Kanban translation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Downstream withdrawal and explicit limits prevent premature production and excess work in process.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Unbounded release creates congestion, long feedback, priority churn and hidden defects.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Queue growth, overproduction, premature commitment and excessive context switching.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Set an explicit bound or release rule for active commitments; admit new work when capacity becomes available; define exceptions and service classes.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Arrival pressure exceeds completion capacity, active work accumulates, or long WIP correlates with delay/quality loss.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For low-volume work with naturally bounded commitments, use a simple finish-before-start norm or periodic capacity check.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Observable WIP boundary; stable item definitions; capacity/replenishment capability; priority and exception policy; no hidden pre-entry queue.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Shorter and more predictable lead time, clearer constraints, faster defect feedback.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Starvation; hidden backlog before entry; arbitrary limits; gaming item size/status; blocking critical long-lead work; apparent cycle-time gains through exclusion.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: A pull signal is not trustworthy demand or capacity; board-level limits can displace queues and invite metric gaming.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Pull was clarified as WIP limitation rather than cards or make-to-order; software translation retained limits but evidence shows optimal limits are contextual.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use empirical limits by work class, monitor blocked/aged work and total demand, and adapt limits with capacity, variability and service risk.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Kanban cards/boards are not required. A database rule, token, CONWIP, admission policy or finite-capacity scheduler can implement it.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What causal evidence is sufficient to distinguish a useful limit from demand suppression or work reclassification?
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: congestion and feedback reduction. Assumes a valid boundary and enough response capacity. Over-application causes starvation or displaced queues. Pair with EL-008 and EL-010.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target system explicitly limit active commitments or merely display them?
Are hidden upstream queues, work-item splitting and exception classes visible?
Does the limit trigger only where congestion is a demonstrated failure mode?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Batch-size economics and small reversible increments
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: TPS setup reduction and small lots; Lean product development and Continuous Delivery translation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Reduce lot size to shorten feedback and lower inventory once setup costs permit.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Large batches delay information, amplify rework and make failures expensive.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Late defect discovery, large release risk, long queue time and irreversible commitment.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Model batch benefits against setup, validation, coordination and transport costs; reduce setup first; choose a reversible economic batch.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Feedback delay or failure blast radius is material and switching/release cost can be reduced.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: If changes are already tiny or validation has a fixed high cost, keep the economic batch and improve feedback within it.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Measurable setup/release costs; modular work; validation capability; rollback/recovery; ability to integrate increments.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Faster learning, smaller failures, lower inventory and release risk.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: One-piece-flow dogma; fragmentation overhead; excessive coordination; local micro-batches accumulating into system batches; unsafe partial delivery.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Smallness is not value; a minimum batch can be uneconomic, and knowledge work may require coherent experimental units.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Generalised from physical lots to information, decisions and software changes; product development added option preservation rather than indiscriminate decomposition.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Select batch size from total economics and reversibility, not a universal minimum; make delayed feedback and blast radius explicit.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: One-piece flow, daily releases or story slicing are implementations, not the property.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should economic batch size be estimated where quality evidence is sparse or validation cost is nonlinear?
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: shorter feedback and smaller failure scope. Assumes manageable setup/validation. Overuse creates fragmentation and coordination waste.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system choose batch size from feedback, setup, validation and failure economics?
Can it use a cheap path when smaller batches would add ceremony or integration cost?
Are locally small batches still bundled into a large end-to-end release?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Setup, changeover, release and feedback latency reduction
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Toyota setup-time reduction and industrial engineering; later software deployment automation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Lower die-change and process-switching time so mixed production and small lots become economical.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: High transition cost forces large batches, inflexibility and infrequent feedback.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Long feedback loops, large economic batches, downtime and costly recovery.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Separate necessary from avoidable setup; externalise safe preparation; simplify interfaces; automate repeatable checks; measure total transition and recovery.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Setup, integration, release or environment preparation materially determines batch size, delay or downtime.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: If setup is rare and immaterial, document the path and avoid an optimisation programme.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Stable interfaces; safe automation; competent maintainers; configuration control; rollback and qualification.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Greater flexibility, smaller economic batches, higher availability and faster learning.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Unsafe shortcuts; preparation shifted to another team; brittle automation; ergonomic or quality risk; faster release of low-value work.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Local setup savings often omit preparation, validation and recovery transferred elsewhere.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Extended from physical die changes to software pipelines, environment provisioning, integration and decision-feedback latency.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Reduce total safe transition cost, including preparation, validation, recovery and burden transferred across boundaries.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: SMED workshops, coloured steps and checklists are optional; lower total transition cost is the property.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which transition costs are shifted to suppliers, operations or workers and therefore missed by local measures?
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: enables smaller batches and flexible capacity. Assumes quality and safety are preserved. Overuse hides transferred work or brittle automation.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is batch size large because setup, release or feedback is expensive, and has that cost been attacked directly?
Does the metric include validation, recovery and transferred work?
Would automation lower total safe transition cost or merely automate a fragile process?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Demand-capacity pacing and production levelling
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Kiichiro/Ohno JIT, takt and heijunka in repetitive automotive production.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use demand pace and mix levelling to coordinate repetitive production and reduce unevenness.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Uncoordinated release creates surges, starvation, overtime and supplier amplification.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Demand/capacity mismatch, violent mix changes, uneven workloads and hidden overburden.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Estimate sustainable pace by work class; level the predictable component; explicitly buffer residual variation; replan when assumptions break.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Repeatable work, measurable aggregate demand, flexible capacity and feasible mix sequencing.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For unique, exploratory or very low-volume work, use finite-capacity planning, rolling forecasts and explicit priority rather than takt ceremony.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Demand information; cross-trained/flexible resources; setup capability; exception policy; workload and ergonomic safeguards; buffers.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Smoother flow, less oscillation, clearer overload and more stable supplier/capacity planning.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: False precision; backlog or overtime used to hide variation; forced pace and work intensification; brittle high-mix schedules; supplier burden transfer.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Takt can become a coercive pace standard; conventional levelling has weak applicability in high-mix/low-volume or discovery work.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Later research narrows conventional levelling to stable/repetitive contexts and develops HMLV adaptations; resilience hybrids preserve reserves.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Level only forecastable aggregate demand, maintain capacity/time buffers and protect workload limits; treat takt as diagnostic, not a metronome.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Takt boards, heijunka boxes and fixed pitch are manufacturing implementations, not general requirements.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Robust rules for levelling highly variable knowledge work remain unresolved; evidence is dominated by manufacturing cases.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: reduces oscillation and overload. Assumes repeatability and demand aggregation. Overuse converts variability into backlog, overtime or supplier stress.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is the work repetitive and demand sufficiently observable for a pace or levelling rule to be meaningful?
Where does residual variation go—capacity reserve, inventory, delay, overtime or suppliers?
Does the mechanism reveal overload or impose an unsafe pace?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Explicit buffer portfolio and strategic slack
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Operations-science refinement of JIT; Toyota capacity practices; post-disruption resilience research.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: JIT sought minimum necessary stock while Toyota also used capacity and time arrangements to absorb variability.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Removing one buffer silently transfers variability and disruption cost to another part of the system.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Fragility, starvation, burnout, missed service, recovery delay and hidden risk transfer.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Model variability, lead times, failure consequence and recovery; assign each inventory, capacity, time, information or redundancy buffer a purpose, owner, activation trigger, size logic and review date.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Variability or disruption cannot be eliminated economically and service or failure consequences are material.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For low-risk, rapidly recoverable work, keep only a small contingency and explicit recovery path.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Demand/failure data; risk appetite; cross-boundary cost visibility; authority to hold reserve; anti-hoarding review.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Lower expected total cost, better recovery, less emergency expediting and reduced human overburden.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Slack becomes unmanaged delay; reserves are raided for utilisation; inventory obsolescence; redundancy hides defects; false quantitative precision.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Classic Lean rhetoric often treats inventory and slack as waste, while disruption and inventory-performance evidence shows non-monotonic returns.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: JIT absolutism was replaced by minimal total buffering cost and segment-specific JIT/JIC/resilience designs.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Optimise a portfolio of justified buffers; distinguish protective reserve from accidental queue and continuously reassess assumptions.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Safety stock, spare capacity, backup suppliers or time contingencies are implementations. No universal buffer is mandatory.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should correlated and deep-tier risks be priced when probabilities are poorly known?
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Core resilience property. Value: absorbs unavoidable variability. Overuse creates cost/latency; underuse creates fragility.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system explicitly choose among inventory, capacity, time, information and redundancy buffers?
Can it distinguish strategic slack from accidental queueing?
Would proposed WIP or inventory reduction merely transfer risk or workload elsewhere?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Flow and queue-aware capacity over maximum local utilisation
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: TPS attack on overproduction and interprocess queues; queueing/operations-science refinement.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Prevent one process from producing work the next process cannot absorb.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: High utilisation under variability creates nonlinear queues and blocks the system constraint.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Congestion, priority churn, long lead time and local output that cannot be absorbed downstream.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Measure queue age/size and end-to-end throughput; reserve response capacity; subordinate nonconstraints; stop releasing work that worsens congestion.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Queues grow despite high activity or local productivity gains fail to improve total outcome.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For low variability and ample capacity, simple utilisation monitoring plus exception handling is enough.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Valid system boundary; capacity/arrival data; authority across silos; protected slack; outcome measures.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Lower congestion, shorter lead time, better service and less emergency work.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Underutilisation without purpose; politically contested spare capacity; local teams penalised for system choices; bottleneck migration.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Lean deployments may still pursue labour or machine utilisation and headcount reduction despite flow doctrine.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Anti-overproduction was strengthened by queueing theory and later flow metrics, while resilience research legitimised spare capacity.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Optimise end-to-end service and total buffering cost; treat utilisation as a constraint or signal, not a target to maximise.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Cell layouts or line-balancing charts are not required; queue-aware admission and capacity rules are alternatives.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should public or safety-critical systems value reserve capacity whose benefit appears only during peaks?
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: avoids congestion collapse. Assumes a meaningful service boundary. Over-application leaves costly idle capacity; under-application creates nonlinear queues.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target system optimise end-to-end throughput and latency or reward local busy time and output?
Is reserve capacity protected where variability makes high utilisation dangerous?
Are queue costs and the location of the constraint visible?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Demand and replenishment information integrity
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Toyota downstream withdrawal/kanban and supplier coordination; later digital flow systems.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use downstream consumption to signal upstream replenishment.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Pull based on stale, distorted or gameable signals amplifies shortages and excess.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: False demand, bullwhip, duplicate work, priority gaming and long-lead omissions.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Define signal source, semantics, freshness, authority, forecast complement and exception path; reconcile consumption with long-lead and capacity data.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Replenishment or release decisions rely on demand signals across time or organisational boundaries.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For direct low-volume requests, use explicit confirmation and a simple backlog.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Trusted item identity; data quality; latency bounds; incentives that do not reward signal manipulation; long-lead visibility.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: More accurate release, fewer shortages/excesses and better capacity planning.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Demand is endogenous or manipulated; urgent work bypasses signals; forecasts ignored; local pull cannot prepare long-lead components.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: A visible pull signal does not establish trustworthy demand or adequate replenishment capability.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Physical kanban became digital replenishment and admission policies; mature form combines actual consumption with forecast, risk and capacity.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A governed demand-information contract, not blind reaction to the latest request.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Physical cards, supermarkets and board movements are optional implementations.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should pull incorporate sparse catastrophic demand and strategic long-lead preparation?
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: truthful release and replenishment. Assumes timely signals and response capability. Failure creates starvation, oscillation or false urgency.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is the demand or pull signal timely, semantically clear and resistant to gaming?
Does the system complement consumption with long-lead, capacity and risk information?
Can urgent exceptions be distinguished from habitual bypass?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Abnormality detection and signalling
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Toyoda loom stop antecedent; Toyota andon and visual control.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Detect an abnormal condition at the source and make it visible to the responsible responder.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Defects, unsafe states and process failures can continue silently until downstream discovery.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Silent propagation, delayed response and normalisation of deviation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Define detectable abnormal states and confidence; instrument or enable human recognition; signal with severity, location, owner and time.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Continued operation after an abnormality materially increases harm, rework, delay or uncertainty.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For rare, low-consequence events, use a manual report with clear ownership rather than continuous instrumentation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Known normal envelope; usable detectors; low-friction human signalling; response ownership; alarm review.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Earlier containment and shorter time to response.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: False alarms, missed detections, alarm fatigue, ambiguous ownership, suppressed signals and throughput pressure.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Detection without response creates theatre; automated detection can encode an incomplete model and workers may be punished for signalling.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Extended from mechanical stops and lights to telemetry, alerts and operator calls; mature form manages precision, severity and responder load.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Detect and signal decision-relevant abnormalities with calibrated severity, accountable response and feedback on false positives/negatives.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: An andon cord or light is optional; alerts, checks, guardrails or human escalation can implement the property.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should detection thresholds be tuned when misses are catastrophic but false alarms erode response capacity?
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system expose material abnormalities early enough to change the outcome?
Are detection accuracy, alarm burden and ownership monitored?
Can a person signal safely when automated detection is absent or wrong?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Bounded stop, containment, escalation and recovery authority
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Jidoka, fixed-position stopping and andon response in Toyota production.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Stop or hold work when an abnormality cannot be resolved within the local cycle.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A recognised defect or unsafe condition continues because throughput pressure overrides containment.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Defect propagation, unsafe continuation and unmanaged emergency escalation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Define severity-based authority to hold, stop, isolate or degrade service; summon support; specify restart/recovery criteria and appeal.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Expected propagation harm exceeds interruption and recovery cost, or safety/quality boundaries are breached.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For low-consequence reversible anomalies, flag and route to a bounded follow-up queue without stopping the whole system.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Psychological/employment safety; available responders; isolation capability; restart authority; false-stop review; recovery path.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Smaller blast radius, faster expert response, safer operation and preserved evidence.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: False stops, alarm fatigue, punitive culture, ignored calls, local stop causing larger system harm, rapid reset without diagnosis.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: A cord does not confer real authority; line pressure can suppress use, and indiscriminate stopping is costly.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: From line stop to tiered containment, circuit breakers, feature flags, quarantine and controlled degradation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Severity-calibrated, non-punitive stop/containment authority with response time, restart criteria, evidence preservation and post-event learning.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A physical cord, red light or universal stop is not required; bounded isolation and escalation are the property.

Who may stop, who must respond, and who may restart?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Quality at source and defect containment

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Do not pass known defective work to the next process; build checks and correction close to creation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: End inspection discovers defects after additional work and obscures causal context.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Downstream rework, defect multiplication, ambiguous ownership and late customer harm.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Place proportionate checks near creation; isolate failed output; preserve trace/evidence; repair or reject under defined criteria.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Defects become more costly or less diagnosable downstream, and source checks have useful sensitivity.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For very low-risk reversible output, use sampled or downstream validation with traceability.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Testability; clear quality criteria; containment path; no incentive to hide defects; qualified repair/release.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Smaller defect escape, faster feedback and less downstream rework.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Over-testing; brittle checks; test gaming; false confidence; quality burden shifted to operators; local pass misses system failure.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Quality at source can become blame at source; inspection does not equal process capability or causal prevention.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Expanded from physical inspection and stop to automated tests, contracts, validation gates and canary release, paired with recovery.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use risk-based source verification and containment with independent system-level assurance where local checks cannot see emergent failure.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Inspection stamps, quality gates or test suites are implementations; early trustworthy containment is the property.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should source checks be balanced against independent assurance for systemic or adversarial failures?
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Are defects detected and contained before avoidable downstream propagation?
Does a local pass actually establish system quality, or is independent assurance needed?
Can workers report defects without absorbing blame for structural causes?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Mistake-proofing and fail-safe constraints
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Toyota/Shingo-associated poka-yoke and built-in quality; broader human-factors convergence.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Design fixtures, sequences or sensors so predictable errors are prevented or immediately exposed.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Known recurrent slips remain possible and rely on vigilance or final inspection.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Repeatable human error, wrong-part use, omitted steps and unsafe state transitions.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Eliminate the error opportunity, constrain invalid states, make the correct action easier, or detect the mistake before propagation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Error mode is recurrent, well understood and cheaply preventable or detectable.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use a clear cue or checklist for infrequent low-consequence tasks rather than hard constraint.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Accurate error model; escape/override for legitimate exceptions; human-factors testing; maintenance.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Lower defect frequency and reduced dependence on memory or vigilance.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Brittle constraints; workarounds; blocking legitimate variation; new failure modes; ignored sensor faults; operator deskilling.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: A device can freeze an incorrect process model and shift error elsewhere; not all complex failure has a local mistake.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: From physical jigs and limit switches to type systems, validation, interlocks and safe defaults.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Risk-based constraint or detection for stable error modes, with tested override, monitoring and revision.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A branded poka-yoke device is unnecessary; any verified fail-safe design may implement the property.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Evidence comparing hard prevention, detection and training across complex socio-technical errors is incomplete.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is there a recurrent, well-understood error mode that design can remove or expose?
Does the constraint preserve legitimate exceptions and fail safely?
Would a hard control solve the cause or merely force workarounds?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Jidoka/autonomation: automate routine operation while reserving human exception judgement
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Toyoda automatic loom and Toyota machine autonomation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Machines operate without constant watching and stop when an abnormality occurs so one person can oversee several.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Humans are consumed by routine monitoring while automation continues producing bad output.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Unattended defect propagation and wasteful human machine-watching.

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Routine is stable enough to automate, abnormalities are detectable, and human attention is scarce or high-value.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Keep manual work where volume is low, judgement dominates or automation cannot fail safely.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Reliable detection; safe state; human response capacity; understandable handoff; maintenance; workload monitoring.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Higher leverage of human attention, earlier containment and lower repetitive monitoring burden.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Automation bias; deskilling; opaque models; alert overload; unsafe autonomous continuation; humans left with only rare hard cases.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Automation may be justified as labour reduction and can worsen surveillance, pace or job quality; 'human touch' rhetoric is not sufficient.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Modern form resembles human-on-the-loop automation with bounded autonomy, observability and graceful degradation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Automate only stable, testable routine work; make uncertainty and abnormality explicit; preserve human competence and safe fallback.

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should organisations preserve human competence when automation makes intervention rare but consequential?
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is automation limited to stable routine work with safe exception handoff?
Can humans understand, override and recover the system?
Does the automation reduce harmful work or merely reduce headcount and concentrate cognitive risk?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Process capability, variation measurement and statistical quality control
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Shared Shewhart/Deming statistical-quality ancestry; Toyota SQC from 1949 and TQC from 1961.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use control charts and statistical methods to distinguish process behaviour, pursue causes and prevent recurrence.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Anecdotal reactions to variation confuse noise with assignable causes and fail to establish capability.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Tampering, recurrent defects, false improvement and unstable output.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Define measures and sampling; examine stability and capability; distinguish common/special causes; test countermeasures over time.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Repeated measurable output where variation matters and observations are sufficiently comparable.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For rare or unique work, use structured case evidence and direct tests rather than force a control chart.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement-system validity; enough observations; statistical competence; stable definitions; authority to change systemic causes.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Earlier instability detection, better causal discrimination and qualified process improvement.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Chart ritual; bad data; arbitrary limits; metric gaming; treating statistical control as fitness for use; ignoring rare catastrophic modes.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Lean accounts sometimes appropriate quality ancestry; Deming did not originate JIT or jidoka, and exact influence on A3/5 Whys is unproven.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Expanded from shop-floor control charts to reliability, experimentation and longitudinal outcome evidence.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use fit-for-purpose variation analysis and capability evidence, explicitly separating stability, customer need and risk.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A control-chart poster, Deming Prize programme or Six Sigma belt is not required.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should sparse, nonstationary and dependent observations be governed without false statistical certainty?
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target distinguish signal from routine variation before changing the process?
Are measurements valid and linked to fitness for use rather than merely stable?
Would statistical machinery add value for this population or create false precision?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Explicit current baseline with controlled revision
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Toyota standardized work (takt, sequence, standard WIP); TWI Job Instruction; later learning-system interpretation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.ORIGINAL_FORM: Specify the current work sequence, pace and standard inventory so it can be taught and managed.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Implicit practice makes deviation, training and improvement impossible to evaluate.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Uncontrolled variation, knowledge loss, untestable change and inconsistent training.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Version the best-known current method, scope, expected result and exceptions; train it; expose deviations; test and authorise revisions.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Work recurs, consistency matters, multiple people perform it or failure consequences require a known baseline.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For one-off low-risk work, retain a short decision record or checklist rather than a full standard-work sheet.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Worker input; valid current evidence; change and exception authority; review owner/date; ergonomic and safety assessment.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Repeatability, faster training, visible deviation and a platform for improvement.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Immutable procedure; stale paperwork; coercive pace; deskilling; suppressed expert judgement; standards written by distant staff; unauthorised workarounds.

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Reinterpreted from prescribed sequence toward an explicit, testable, provisional baseline with lifecycle controls.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A scoped, versioned, teachable baseline with exceptions, evidence, local challenge rights, qualification, expiry and retirement.

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Historical evidence for explicit expiry/retirement inside Toyota is limited; those safeguards are evolved engineering additions.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system distinguish a current baseline from an immutable rule?
Who may deviate, propose revision, qualify the change and retire the standard?
Is the baseline still valid, usable and safe rather than paperwork compliance?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Direct observation combined with traceable system evidence

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Material uncertainty exists about what actually happens or reports conflict with outcomes.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For well-instrumented, low-risk routine work, sample direct observation periodically and investigate exceptions.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Access; non-punitive observation; representative sampling; traceability; skill in distinguishing observation from inference.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Better problem framing, discovery of unrecorded work and stronger causal hypotheses.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system obtain evidence from actual work rather than reports alone?
Is direct observation triangulated with traces, outcomes and affected people's testimony?
Could the observation process distort work or become surveillance?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Evidence-bound problem solving and countermeasure qualification

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Symptoms recur because fixes are selected without causal evidence or tested only once.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Template-driven action, single-root stories, recurrence and false learning.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MECHANISM: Define problem and baseline; gather evidence; develop competing causal hypotheses; predict effects; test safely; compare results; check side effects and recurrence.

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a trivial one-off reversible issue, fix and record the observation; escalate only on recurrence.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Time and skill; data/provenance; ability to test; independent challenge; authority over causes; follow-up owner.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Fewer recurrences, stronger learning and countermeasures that survive outside the initial event.

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Moved from named templates toward explicit scientific reasoning, systems causation and countermeasure qualification.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A proportional causal-learning loop with competing hypotheses, predictions, safe tests, outcome/side-effect evidence and recurrence review.

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which problem classes justify experimentation, formal causal analysis or independent review remains context-dependent.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does repeated failure produce competing causal hypotheses and a qualified countermeasure rather than a completed template?
Are predictions, disconfirming evidence, side effects and recurrence checked?
Would a cheap fix suffice, or is the causal uncertainty consequential enough to trigger the full loop?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Improvement sustainment, expiry, retirement and economics

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For ephemeral low-risk changes, define a short observation period and automatic expiry.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Baseline and outcome data; ownership; ability to remove controls; preserved rationale; leadership continuity.
EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Durable gains, lower bureaucracy, timely removal of obsolete controls and transparent improvement economics.

Can obsolete standards, controls and metrics expire or be retired?
Does maintenance cost exceed the current value of the improvement?

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.PROPERTY_NAME: Worker capability, training and cross-skilling

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Skill bottlenecks, unsafe improvisation, slow recovery and dependence on a few experts.

EVOLVED_LEAN_PROPERTY_LEDGER.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For rare low-risk work, retain accessible guidance and an expert escalation path rather than broad certification.

QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Do people have trained capability to execute, detect abnormality, recover and improve—not just responsibility?
Is cross-skilling supported by time, pay and staffing rather than used as headcount extraction?
Is competence verified and refreshed when the baseline changes?
