EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VARIABILITY_ASSUMPTIONS: Arrival, service-time and priority variation are observable enough to tune the bound; critical exceptions have a policy.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.BUFFER_ASSUMPTIONS: WIP is one buffer; reducing it may require capacity or time slack and cannot eliminate variability.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Starvation, hidden pre-entry queues, blocked-work accumulation, priority inversion and card/ticket gaming.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.RESILIENCE_TRADEOFF: Very tight limits improve focus but reduce ability to absorb bursts or maintain parallel recovery paths.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.CHEAP_PATH: Use a simple 'finish before starting' rule or one team-level commitment cap; no board required.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.MATURE_FORM: Class-aware admission control calibrated to demand, capacity, lead time and service risk, with explicit override evidence.

EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.PROPERTY: Batch-size economics and small reversible increments
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VALUE_MECHANISM: Shortens feedback, lowers defect/change blast radius and reduces inventory tied up between decisions.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VARIABILITY_ASSUMPTIONS: Smaller transfers yield information before the next irreversible commitment; items can be partitioned without losing essential integrity.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.BUFFER_ASSUMPTIONS: Setup, validation and coordination overhead are real counter-buffers; batch size cannot be chosen independently of them.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Excessive transaction cost, fragmentary outputs, test overhead, context switching and loss of economies of scale.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.RESILIENCE_TRADEOFF: Small increments aid rollback, but too little batching can remove redundancy or coordinated end-to-end validation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.CHEAP_PATH: Split only the next high-risk decision or release rather than decompose all work.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.MATURE_FORM: Choose batch and transfer size by setup cost, feedback value, coupling, failure blast radius and reversibility.

EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VALUE_MECHANISM: Reduces the fixed cost that makes large batches economical and accelerates detection, recovery and learning.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VARIABILITY_ASSUMPTIONS: The setup or release delay is a material component of total latency and is reducible without disproportionate risk.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.BUFFER_ASSUMPTIONS: Faster change/release can substitute for inventory or time buffers, but qualification and safety capacity must remain.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Optimising rare setup, moving work off-book, unsafe shortcuts or automation maintenance exceeding benefit.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.RESILIENCE_TRADEOFF: Automation can speed recovery but creates toolchain dependencies and common-mode failure.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.CHEAP_PATH: Pre-stage, checklist or automate the single slowest/repeated step before building a full platform.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.MATURE_FORM: Reduce fixed transition and feedback costs while preserving independent qualification, fallback and economic review.

EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VALUE_MECHANISM: Smooths avoidable load oscillation, exposes mismatch and reduces batch/schedule amplification in repetitive work.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VARIABILITY_ASSUMPTIONS: A stable aggregate demand component and reasonably bounded processing-time/mix variation exist.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.BUFFER_ASSUMPTIONS: Residual variation is absorbed by capacity, time, finished stock or service policy; levelling does not make it vanish.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Backlog, overtime, supplier oscillation, coercive pacing and poor response to rare or high-variety demand.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.RESILIENCE_TRADEOFF: Smoothing aids stability but can reduce responsiveness to real regime changes.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.CHEAP_PATH: Level only a recurring work class or reserve a small capacity band instead of imposing universal takt.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.MATURE_FORM: Adaptive demand-capacity envelope with explicit residual-variation buffers and exception classes.

EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.PROPERTY: Explicit buffer portfolio and strategic slack
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VALUE_MECHANISM: Chooses how variability and disruption will be absorbed rather than allowing hidden queues, lateness or cancelled demand to become the default buffer.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VARIABILITY_ASSUMPTIONS: Material variability and failure modes can be characterised at least qualitatively; not all sources are removable.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.BUFFER_ASSUMPTIONS: Inventory, capacity and time are core buffers; information, redundancy, scope flexibility and recovery options may supplement them.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Unreviewed inventory, idle capacity, bureaucratic contingency plans and resilience theatre.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.RESILIENCE_TRADEOFF: More protection costs money and can hide problems; less protection raises tail-loss and recovery risk.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.CHEAP_PATH: For each critical variability source, name the current buffer and owner before adding anything.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.MATURE_FORM: Governed portfolio with purpose, activation trigger, service/risk target, owner, cost, adequacy test and review/retirement date.

EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.PROPERTY: Flow/queue-aware capacity over maximum local utilisation
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VALUE_MECHANISM: Preserves service and throughput under variability by avoiding queue explosion near full utilisation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VARIABILITY_ASSUMPTIONS: Arrivals or service times vary; shared resources create queue interactions.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.BUFFER_ASSUMPTIONS: Capacity slack is an intentional buffer whose cost is compared with delay, lost throughput and failure cost.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Excess capacity without purpose, underinvestment in variability reduction or political protection of idle resources.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.RESILIENCE_TRADEOFF: Slack improves burst response, maintenance and learning but can lower apparent unit utilisation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.CHEAP_PATH: Stop treating utilisation as a target; first monitor queue growth and missed service at current load.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.MATURE_FORM: Capacity policy based on variability, queue/service target, maintenance, recovery and economic loss—not maximum busy time.

EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VALUE_MECHANISM: Prevents false pull, bullwhip, duplicate production and stockout caused by delayed or corrupted consumption signals.

EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.BUFFER_ASSUMPTIONS: Information quality can reduce but never eliminate physical/time/capacity buffers.

EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VALUE_MECHANISM: Reduces internal variability, unplanned stops and the buffer burden needed to maintain flow.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VARIABILITY_ASSUMPTIONS: Failure modes recur enough to justify preventive, predictive or design action.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.BUFFER_ASSUMPTIONS: Maintenance windows, spares and responder capacity are legitimate buffers; zero downtime is not assumed.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Over-maintenance, sensor noise, costly redundancy or optimisation for availability rather than mission outcome.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.RESILIENCE_TRADEOFF: Planned downtime and spare capacity reduce nominal utilisation but improve recovery and tail performance.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.CHEAP_PATH: Stabilise the dominant recurrent failure and define a restoration runbook before deploying predictive infrastructure.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.MATURE_FORM: Risk-based reliability programme linking failure mode, detection, maintainability, recovery, spare/skill capacity and learning.

EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.PROPERTY: Multi-tier dependency visibility and resilience segmentation
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VALUE_MECHANISM: Identifies critical lower-tier concentration, lead time and recovery constraints before disruption propagates.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VARIABILITY_ASSUMPTIONS: Supplier/dependency topology and criticality can be mapped sufficiently; common-mode risks change over time.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.BUFFER_ASSUMPTIONS: Different segments justify different mixes of stock, capacity, alternate source, regionalisation and recovery agreement.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Mapping burden, false confidence, supplier surveillance, frozen classifications and duplication with no feasible switch path.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.RESILIENCE_TRADEOFF: Diversity and redundancy cost more and can weaken learning economies; concentration improves coordination but raises correlated risk.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.CHEAP_PATH: Map only critical single points of failure and the first unknown tier; test one recovery scenario.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.MATURE_FORM: Criticality- and turbulence-based segmentation with multi-tier provenance, viable recovery options, fair cost allocation and periodic stress tests.

EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.PROPERTY: Software delivery flow with automation, observability, reliability and recovery
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VALUE_MECHANISM: Small, qualified changes shorten feedback and reduce release blast radius while observability and recovery preserve service.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.VARIABILITY_ASSUMPTIONS: Changes differ in risk and coupling; telemetry and automated tests provide partial—not complete—evidence.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.BUFFER_ASSUMPTIONS: Deployment capacity, rollback paths, feature controls, on-call recovery and architectural decoupling are buffers/capabilities.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.FAILURE_IF_OVER_APPLIED: Shipping low-value work faster, flaky automation, metric gaming, alert fatigue, underfunded architecture and unsafe continuous change.
EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.RESILIENCE_TRADEOFF: Higher change frequency can improve recovery and learning but increases exposure unless qualification and rollback are reliable.

EVOLVED_LEAN_FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILES.MATURE_FORM: Risk-tiered small changes with automated evidence, observability, safe release controls, reliability objectives, human factors and verified recovery.

STAGES.PURPOSE: State the expected condition, tolerance and consequence class.
STAGES.MINIMUM_EVIDENCE: Current baseline, quality/safety boundary and known exceptions.
STAGES.FAILURE_MODE: No stable reference; every deviation is subjective or every variation becomes an alarm.

STAGES.PURPOSE: Recognise deviation close enough to the source to prevent costly propagation.
STAGES.MINIMUM_EVIDENCE: Detector coverage, latency, false-negative/false-positive behaviour and observability.
STAGES.FAILURE_MODE: Undetected defect, noisy monitor, hidden detector failure or over-trust in automation.

STAGES.PURPOSE: Transfer the abnormal state, location and urgency to a responsible responder.
STAGES.MINIMUM_EVIDENCE: Named recipient, acknowledgement path, freshness and signal provenance.
STAGES.FAILURE_MODE: Alarm without owner, stigma for signalling, stale board or alert flood.

STAGES.PURPOSE: Classify severity, propagation risk, scope and whether continuation is safe.
STAGES.MINIMUM_EVIDENCE: Consequence model, affected population/work, uncertainty and decision threshold.
STAGES.FAILURE_MODE: Every alert stops everything; serious defects are normalised; throughput pressure biases classification.

STAGES.PURPOSE: Prevent additional defective/unsafe work from escaping while preserving unaffected operation when possible.
STAGES.MINIMUM_EVIDENCE: Containment boundary, stop scope, expected propagation and safe-state criterion.
STAGES.AUTHORITY: WORKER_LOCAL for signal; predefined TEAM/SYSTEM authority for stop scope
STAGES.FAILURE_MODE: Detected but not contained; unnecessary global stop; hidden rework queue; unsafe override.

STAGES.PURPOSE: Recover service without erasing the abnormality or creating uncontrolled debt.
STAGES.MINIMUM_EVIDENCE: Restoration test, fallback/rollback, temporary-control owner and expiry.
STAGES.FAILURE_MODE: Reset-and-forget, repeated workaround, premature restart or customer exposure.

STAGES.PURPOSE: Explain why the control environment allowed the failure, including interacting and organisational causes.
STAGES.MINIMUM_EVIDENCE: Competing hypotheses, causal evidence, boundary/assumption record and uncertainty.
STAGES.FAILURE_MODE: Single arbitrary root, operator blame, five-why story or local cause standing in for system cause.

STAGES.PURPOSE: Change a controllable mechanism at the strongest feasible level of the control hierarchy.
STAGES.MINIMUM_EVIDENCE: Mechanism, prediction, side effects, owner, cost and rollback.
STAGES.FAILURE_MODE: Training/reminder chosen by default, cause/control mismatch, burden transferred to worker or supplier.

STAGES.PURPOSE: Test that the countermeasure controls the failure without unacceptable new risk and that restart conditions hold.
STAGES.MINIMUM_EVIDENCE: Pre-specified success/failure criteria, repeated or staged test, data over time where appropriate, independent check for high consequence.
STAGES.FAILURE_MODE: One successful run treated as proof, no prediction, no regression evidence or authority ambiguity.

STAGES.PURPOSE: Integrate verified learning, watch recurrence and remove temporary or obsolete controls.
STAGES.MINIMUM_EVIDENCE: Versioned baseline, recurrence measure, review date, maintenance burden and retirement test.
STAGES.FAILURE_MODE: Lessons recorded but baseline unchanged; alert/control accretion; stale workaround becomes permanent.

REQUIRED_DISTINCTIONS: line or service stopped != root cause understood
countermeasure passed once != recurrence risk controlled
worker may signal != worker is safe from blame or retaliation
automation detected a modelled condition != unmodelled failure is safe
low false-negative rate != tolerable alert burden
local containment != end-to-end customer or system protection
restart authorised != temporary control can remain indefinitely

LIFECYCLE.REQUIREMENT: Use a baseline only where repeatability, consequence, training or comparison value justifies it.
LIFECYCLE.EVIDENCE_BEFORE_CHANGE: Failure/variation or teaching need; avoid standardising exploratory judgement prematurely.
LIFECYCLE.FAILURE_IF_MISSING: Paperwork for trivial or unstable work.

LIFECYCLE.REQUIREMENT: Record how work is performed, including variants, workarounds, constraints and tacit judgement.
Connect the baseline to quality, safety, flow or learning—not obedience.
LIFECYCLE.EVIDENCE_BEFORE_CHANGE: Named failure mode and expected outcome.
LIFECYCLE.FAILURE_IF_MISSING: Compliance can rise while performance falls.

LIFECYCLE.REQUIREMENT: Identify scope, revision, owner, prerequisites, sequence/constraints and applicable work class.
LIFECYCLE.EVIDENCE_BEFORE_CHANGE: Current process capability and known operating envelope.
LIFECYCLE.FAILURE_IF_MISSING: Competing unwritten standards and no reliable comparison.

LIFECYCLE.REQUIREMENT: Specify when the baseline does not apply and who may depart safely.
LIFECYCLE.EVIDENCE_BEFORE_CHANGE: Known variability, edge cases and risk classification.
LIFECYCLE.FAILURE_IF_MISSING: Expert judgement is suppressed or deviations go underground.

LIFECYCLE.REQUIREMENT: Teach purpose and method; verify performance rather than attendance.
LIFECYCLE.EVIDENCE_BEFORE_CHANGE: Observed execution, comprehension and safe escalation ability.
LIFECYCLE.FAILURE_IF_MISSING: Standard exists only on paper; worker blamed for system/training defects.

LIFECYCLE.STEP: 7. MAKE DEVIATION VISIBLE AND SAFE TO REPORT
LIFECYCLE.REQUIREMENT: Deviation should trigger help or inquiry, not automatic blame.
LIFECYCLE.EVIDENCE_BEFORE_CHANGE: Signal use, response time, no-retaliation and workload evidence.

LIFECYCLE.REQUIREMENT: State mechanism, expected outcome, affected constraints and rollback.
LIFECYCLE.AUTHORITY: WORKER_LOCAL for bounded reversible change; otherwise scaled authority
LIFECYCLE.FAILURE_IF_MISSING: Idea volume or preference replaces learning.

LIFECYCLE.REQUIREMENT: Use the smallest safe test capable of discriminating the hypothesis.
Compare results with prediction, adverse effects and baseline; update version only when evidence is adequate.
LIFECYCLE.FAILURE_IF_MISSING: Anecdote becomes standard; local gain transfers harm.

LIFECYCLE.REQUIREMENT: Assign review triggers for changed product, demand, equipment, law, architecture or evidence.
LIFECYCLE.EVIDENCE_BEFORE_CHANGE: Drift, recurrence, exception frequency and upkeep burden.

LIFECYCLE.REQUIREMENT: Remove obsolete, harmful or uneconomic baselines and temporary controls; preserve provenance.
LIFECYCLE.EVIDENCE_BEFORE_CHANGE: No remaining failure mode, superior replacement, unacceptable side effect or cost.

AUTHORITY_MODEL.VALID_SCOPE: Signal abnormality; stop personal unsafe work; execute pre-authorised reversible adjustment; propose change.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.REQUIRED_GUARDRAIL: No retaliation, known envelope, traceability and rapid support.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.NOT_SUFFICIENT_FOR: Cross-system, regulatory, safety-critical or irreversible baseline change.

AUTHORITY_MODEL.VALID_SCOPE: Tune bounded work method, local WIP, visual state and low-blast-radius experiment.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.NOT_SUFFICIENT_FOR: Changes transferring load or risk outside the team.

AUTHORITY_MODEL.VALID_SCOPE: Resource immediate response, coordinate containment, training and local recovery.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.REQUIRED_GUARDRAIL: Cannot suppress signals to meet output targets; escalation clock/criteria.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.NOT_SUFFICIENT_FOR: Structural staffing, supplier or architecture causes beyond span.

AUTHORITY_MODEL.VALID_SCOPE: Resolve handoffs, product/process trade-offs, systemic causes and multi-area countermeasures.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.REQUIRED_GUARDRAIL: Named end-to-end outcome and affected-party representation.

AUTHORITY_MODEL.VALID_SCOPE: Set system constraints, buffers, staffing, supplier/resilience policy, adoption and retirement.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.REQUIRED_GUARDRAIL: Evidence, accountability for externalities and review of worker/customer impact.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.NOT_SUFFICIENT_FOR: Unilateral override of legal, safety or independent assurance authority.

AUTHORITY_MODEL.VALID_SCOPE: Scaled by reversibility, blast radius, uncertainty and consequence.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.REQUIRED_GUARDRAIL: Explicit authority matrix before the abnormality or experiment.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.NOT_SUFFICIENT_FOR: Vague 'everyone owns quality' with no decision rights.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.SIDE_A_PROPERTY: EL-006/EL-009 reduction of delay and excess cost
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Frequent, low-consequence, rapidly recoverable work with stable supply and measurable carrying cost.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: High-consequence failure, correlated disruption, long recovery or opaque dependencies.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Segment by criticality; remove accidental queues while funding named capacity, stock, alternate-source and recovery buffers.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Tail probabilities and common-mode failure are hard to estimate.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Congestion, multitasking and delayed feedback dominate.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Burst response, parallel recovery or exploration requires ready capacity/options.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Limit committed execution WIP while reserving explicit response and discovery capacity outside the queue.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Organisations may relabel hidden WIP as 'slack' or cut genuine slack as 'unused capacity'.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Stable repetitive work, safety-critical sequence, training and high recurrence.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Novel, ambiguous, rapidly changing or highly contextual work.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Versioned baseline with explicit discretion/exception envelope and evidence-based revision rights.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Power asymmetry can make nominal change authority unreal.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Known solution path, low uncertainty, reversible delivery.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: High design uncertainty, strong coupling and costly irreversible choices.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Limit execution WIP but maintain a budgeted evidence-generating option set until discriminating information arrives.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Parallel work may continue after its option value expires.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.SIDE_B_PROPERTY: EL-007/EL-008 advance capacity and inventory planning
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Short replenishment latency and reliable capacity.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Long lead-time materials, seasonal demand, regulated capacity or rare skills.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Place a decoupling point: forecast/plan upstream where lead time demands it, pull downstream with explicit WIP.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Bad interface placement transfers forecast error or stockout risk.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.SIDE_B_PROPERTY: EL-024/EL-025 system ownership and whole-path metrics
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Bounded cause and consequence within team control.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Bottleneck, incentive, architecture or supplier cause crosses boundaries.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Define escalation thresholds and require local changes to test end-to-end and externality effects.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: System owners may become bottlenecks or use centralisation to suppress local agency.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: High propagation, safety or customer harm; cheap bounded stop.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Noisy detector, low consequence, high restart cost or essential service continuity.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Tiered signal, fixed-position response window, scoped containment, small defined buffer and calibrated stop threshold.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Throughput pressure can silently move thresholds toward unsafe continuation.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Survival constraint where alternatives and negotiated transition exist.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Continuous worker-driven improvement requires long-run candour and cooperation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Advance no-layoff/redeployment rules, gain sharing, negotiated transition and natural-attrition planning where feasible.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Economic shocks may defeat promises; contingent workforces can bear displaced risk.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.SIDE_A_PROPERTY: EL-027 joint capability and timely replenishment
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Stable nearby supply, strong trust, low common-mode risk.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Critical long-lead components, geopolitical/climate risk, tier opacity or concentrated capacity.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Deep collaboration for capable sources plus tier mapping, alternate recovery and strategic stock/capacity for critical segments.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Second sources may not be truly independent or qualified at disruption scale.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Duplicated work has no information, safety or recovery value.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Independent verification, fault tolerance, learning options or surge/recovery capacity are valuable.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Require a purpose and adequacy test for redundancy; remove it only after a stronger control exists.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Benefits often appear only in rare events and are undervalued by short-horizon accounting.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.SIDE_B_PROPERTY: EL-020 sustainment and bounded improvement economics
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Material recurrent loss and available improvement capacity.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Stable adequate process, overloaded workforce or marginal ideas.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Budget improvement capacity, prioritise by expected loss, stop low-value campaigns and consolidate/retire controls.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Management may shift improvement labour onto workers without time or reward.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Cheap reversible experiments and clear discriminating evidence.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Evidence arrives late and decisions create irreversible architecture/tooling commitments.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Run fast tests across a bounded option set and converge only when elimination criteria are met.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Fast tests may measure proxies that favour the wrong option.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Tacit work, ergonomic condition, user behaviour or report distortion.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Rare, distributed, latent or long-horizon failure.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Triangulate field observation with logs, samples, models and affected-party testimony.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: What is visible and visitable attracts disproportionate attention.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.TENSION: Visual transparency versus surveillance and gaming
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Shared state is needed for coordination and response.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Measures can identify or punish individuals, or work is hard to compare.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Aggregate system metrics, limit access, audit gaming, prohibit individual quotas and include qualitative context.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Power holders may repurpose diagnostic data after collection.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.SIDE_A_PROPERTY: EL-015 autonomation and EL-031 delivery automation
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.SIDE_B_PROPERTY: EL-021 capability and EL-012 human escalation
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Routine, stable, observable condition with reliable oracle and safe fallback.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Novel, ambiguous, adversarial or high-consequence exception.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Bounded automation with transparent state, human override, competency retention and tested fallback.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Automation may erode the very human skill needed during rare failure.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.SIDE_A_PROPERTY: EL-013 source quality and EL-019 qualification
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: High defect consequence or weak downstream detection.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Low-risk reversible change with strong monitoring/rollback.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Risk-tiered evidence gates, canary release and containment proportional to consequence.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: Risk tiers can be manipulated to bypass controls.

EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.TENSION: Value to the customer versus labour, supplier and public constraints
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_A: Preferences do not externalise material harm and customer outcome is legitimate.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.CONTEXT_THAT_FAVOURS_B: Cost or speed gains rely on unsafe work, supplier precarity or public risk.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.KNOWN_HYBRID_RESOLUTION: Define value as constrained multi-stakeholder outcome, not willingness-to-pay alone.
EVOLVED_LEAN_INTERNAL_TENSIONS.UNRESOLVED_RISK: No neutral aggregation rule resolves all conflicts.

EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.WHAT_WAS_IMPORTED_OR_CONVERGED: Control charts, variation reasoning, company-wide quality and disciplined study.
EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.BOUNDARY: Do not credit Lean/TPS with originating the entire quality tradition or assume a PDCA label proves statistical learning.

EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.WHAT_WAS_IMPORTED_OR_CONVERGED: Formal WIP definition of pull and inventory/capacity/time buffer economics under variability.
EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.BOUNDARY: Analytical models abstract from labour, power, safety and meaning of work; combine, do not substitute.

EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.WHAT_WAS_IMPORTED_OR_CONVERGED: Autonomy, workload, job design, trust, health, support and distribution of gains as causal constraints.
EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.BOUNDARY: Respect rhetoric cannot stand in for measured worker outcomes or bargaining power.

EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.WHAT_WAS_IMPORTED_OR_CONVERGED: Set-based alternatives, front-loaded learning, cross-functional integration and reusable trade-off knowledge.
EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.BOUNDARY: Not a direct transplant of repetitive factory flow; comparative causal evidence remains limited.

EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.WHAT_WAS_IMPORTED_OR_CONVERGED: Workflow visibility, explicit WIP and evolutionary policy change.
EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.BOUNDARY: Cards/tickets are heterogeneous knowledge claims; a board cannot expose architecture or create testability.

EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.WHAT_WAS_IMPORTED_OR_CONVERGED: Automated qualification, small releases, observability, rollback, reliability and recovery.
EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.BOUNDARY: Much derives independently from software engineering and operations; speed metrics remain proxies.

EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.WHAT_WAS_IMPORTED_OR_CONVERGED: Multi-tier mapping, criticality segmentation, redundancy, inventory/capacity options and recovery planning.
EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.BOUNDARY: Neither JIT nor stockpiling alone is resilient; buffers require viable replenishment/recovery paths.

EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.WHAT_WAS_IMPORTED_OR_CONVERGED: Patient-flow, handoff and safety visibility; domain outcome evaluation.
EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.BOUNDARY: Professional judgement, care quality and patient outcomes cannot be reduced to factory throughput.

EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.WHAT_WAS_IMPORTED_OR_CONVERGED: Multiple causation, control hierarchy, barrier reasoning and rejection of arbitrary single roots.
EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.BOUNDARY: Five Whys and local fixes are inadequate for complex sociotechnical incidents.

EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.WHAT_WAS_IMPORTED_OR_CONVERGED: Planned maintenance, maintainability, failure-mode control, spares, recovery and availability economics.
EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.BOUNDARY: Nominal utilisation and inventory metrics must not erase maintenance windows or recovery capacity.

EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.WHAT_WAS_IMPORTED_OR_CONVERGED: Multidimensional productivity, satisfaction, communication and performance safeguards around delivery metrics.
EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.BOUNDARY: No single cycle-time, throughput or DORA measure should become an individual target or value claim.

EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.WHAT_WAS_IMPORTED_OR_CONVERGED: Group technology, workload control and adaptive planning where classic levelling assumptions fail.
EVOLVED_LEAN_HYBRIDISATION_PRESSURES.BOUNDARY: Classic takt/heijunka is manufacturing-specific and may need replacement, not cosmetic adaptation.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How should constrained value aggregate customer, worker, supplier, public-safety and ecological interests when they conflict?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: No Lean-native aggregation rule resolves distributive conflict.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What empirical threshold identifies when additional end-to-end mapping is worth its instrumentation and maintenance cost?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Most evidence is case-based and bundled with management attention.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How should WIP limits be tuned for heterogeneous work classes, blocked work and rare urgent demand without creating hidden queues?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Formal queue models simplify priority, dependency and behavioural gaming.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What decision rule best balances batch size, setup cost, validation cost, option value and failure blast radius in knowledge work?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: No universal economic model covers all software/design contexts.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Where is classic takt/levelling superior to workload control or dynamic scheduling in high-mix, high-variability environments?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Evidence is domain-specific and implementation-dependent.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How should organisations quantify low-frequency disruption benefits so strategic buffers survive short-horizon cost pressure?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Tail probabilities, common-mode dependencies and option viability are uncertain.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How much capacity slack is economically optimal when queueing, maintenance, learning and recovery share the same reserve?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Costs and uses interact; labels can hide unowned idle time.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How can pull systems preserve signal integrity under cancellations, strategic demand shaping and automated feedback loops?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Historical kanban assumes stronger physical coupling than many digital markets provide.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What alarm/stop thresholds minimise combined false-negative propagation and false-positive interruption cost in different consequence classes?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Thresholds are technology- and hazard-specific; Lean literature is not sufficient.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: When does mistake-proofing reduce adaptive capacity or create automation complacency?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Benefits are strong for stable error modes but side effects are context-specific.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What minimum statistical capability should precede aggressive inventory/WIP reduction?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: No single threshold covers service consequence, lead time and failure distribution.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How should standard-work expiry and retirement be calibrated without causing needless review bureaucracy?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Expiry/retirement are evolved safeguards with limited direct comparative evidence.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Which problem types can safely use a lightweight Five-Whys prompt, and when is systems causal analysis mandatory?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Complexity/consequence boundaries require domain safety knowledge.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What designs make frontline participation genuinely decision-bearing rather than an intensification mechanism?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Empirical effects remain mixed across work complexity, labour institutions and management choices.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How durable are employment-security and gain-sharing commitments under downturns, automation and contingent work?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Historical compacts do not generalise across legal and economic regimes.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How can management responsibility be enforced when structural causes span owners, suppliers and regulators?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: End-to-end authority often does not match dependency topology.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Which metric portfolios remain diagnostic after teams learn the definitions and incentives?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Goodhart effects and metric drift are persistent; no permanent gaming-proof set exists.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How should supplier-development gains and resilience costs be allocated so the focal firm does not externalise risk?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Toyota network evidence shows capability benefits but not a universal fair-allocation model.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What comparative evidence establishes set-based design's net benefit after accounting for parallel exploration cost?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: The review literature reports conceptual maturity but limited practical causal comparison.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How should software delivery metrics be linked to product value, architecture health, security and human sustainability?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Delivery-performance and productivity frameworks are observational and proxy-based.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: When should low-value work be stopped immediately versus retained as an option, maintenance obligation or resilience reserve?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Option value and abandonment cost are often poorly observed.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How much of Lean's observed performance is attributable to bundled institutions rather than individually transferable properties?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Bundled observational studies create identification and interaction problems.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Can positive healthcare/service flow results be sustained without degrading worker outcomes or narrowing care quality?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Systematic reviews report heterogeneous and often weak outcome evidence.

EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Which resilience adaptations remain JIT, and does the naming question have any engineering consequence?
EVOLVED_LEAN_OPEN_QUESTIONS.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: The JIT/JIC boundary is partly definitional; mechanism and fit matter more than brand.

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Outcome and value definition with named beneficiary, constraints and time horizon
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Efficient delivery of low-value, harmful or locally beneficial work.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Use an explicit value hypothesis with beneficiary, outcome, constraints, evidence threshold, review date and abandonment rule.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Multiple plausible outputs compete, resources are material, or local efficiency could displace customer/system value.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For trivial, reversible work, record a one-sentence purpose and acceptance condition rather than create a value-stream artefact.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Legitimate beneficiary representation; outcome observability; explicit non-negotiable constraints; authority to stop low-value work.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Lean literature specifies waste more richly than value; customer language can ignore workers, suppliers, public risk and long-term resilience.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: No Lean vocabulary, value workshop or value-stream map is required; the property is a decision-relevant outcome model.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target system name the beneficiary, desired outcome, constraints and time horizon rather than equating output or waste removal with value?
Can it stop or retire work when the value hypothesis fails?
Are labour, safety, resilience and external costs prevented from disappearing behind a customer-value claim?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: End-to-end system boundary and flow/queue/handoff visibility
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Local optimisation and invisible waiting across organisational boundaries.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Maintain the cheapest decision-useful end-to-end model, including feedback/rework loops, queues, dependencies and outcome—not just touch time.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Repeated handoffs, unexplained elapsed time, departmental optimisation or customer delay dominate processing time.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For a short single-owner path, a simple trace or sampled timeline is enough; no wall-sized map.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: End-to-end latency, queue and handoff profile; assumes valid item identity and boundary. Over-instrumentation and forced linearisation are failure modes.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Stable item identity; traceability across boundaries; truthful timestamps/states; an owner able to resolve cross-boundary causes.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Value-stream maps are frequently local snapshots and can mistake visible factory-like sequence for the real distributed causal system.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: A value-stream map is one implementation. Event logs, service blueprints, dependency graphs or sampled traces may be stronger.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system expose end-to-end waiting, queues, handoffs, rework and outcome latency rather than only local activity?
Is the map or trace current enough to change a decision?
Does it preserve a cheap path where the work is already short, observable and single-owner?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Workplace and work-state legibility
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Undetected abnormality, lost work, excessive search and ambiguous ownership.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Make the minimum relevant normal/abnormal state visible to people who can act, with freshness, accessibility and ownership controls.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Work is repeatedly lost, searched for, misrouted, duplicated or left in an ambiguous state.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: When state is already obvious and low-risk, use naming conventions or a small status field; do not create ritual boards or audit scoring.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Shared state definitions; maintenance ownership; accessibility; protection against surveillance and stale displays.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Evidence for exact 5S bundles is small and heterogeneous; legibility can become discipline and scoring rather than aid.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: 5S labels, shadow boards and kanban columns are optional; cleanliness scores are not the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Can responsible people tell the current and abnormal state without reconstructing it manually?
Are displays fresh, action-linked and non-punitive rather than ceremonial surveillance?
Would additional visual management solve a real ambiguity or merely add another board?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Conditional pull/release control and explicit WIP limits
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Queue growth, overproduction, premature commitment and excessive context switching.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Use empirical limits by work class, monitor blocked/aged work and total demand, and adapt limits with capacity, variability and service risk.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Arrival pressure exceeds completion capacity, active work accumulates, or long WIP correlates with delay/quality loss.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For low-volume work with naturally bounded commitments, use a simple finish-before-start norm or periodic capacity check.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: congestion and feedback reduction. Assumes a valid boundary and enough response capacity. Over-application causes starvation or displaced queues. Pair with EL-008 and EL-010.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Observable WIP boundary; stable item definitions; capacity/replenishment capability; priority and exception policy; no hidden pre-entry queue.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: A pull signal is not trustworthy demand or capacity; board-level limits can displace queues and invite metric gaming.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: Kanban cards/boards are not required. A database rule, token, CONWIP, admission policy or finite-capacity scheduler can implement it.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target system explicitly limit active commitments or merely display them?
Are hidden upstream queues, work-item splitting and exception classes visible?
Does the limit trigger only where congestion is a demonstrated failure mode?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Batch-size economics and small reversible increments
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Late defect discovery, large release risk, long queue time and irreversible commitment.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Select batch size from total economics and reversibility, not a universal minimum; make delayed feedback and blast radius explicit.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Feedback delay or failure blast radius is material and switching/release cost can be reduced.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: If changes are already tiny or validation has a fixed high cost, keep the economic batch and improve feedback within it.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: shorter feedback and smaller failure scope. Assumes manageable setup/validation. Overuse creates fragmentation and coordination waste.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Measurable setup/release costs; modular work; validation capability; rollback/recovery; ability to integrate increments.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Smallness is not value; a minimum batch can be uneconomic, and knowledge work may require coherent experimental units.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: One-piece flow, daily releases or story slicing are implementations, not the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system choose batch size from feedback, setup, validation and failure economics?
Can it use a cheap path when smaller batches would add ceremony or integration cost?
Are locally small batches still bundled into a large end-to-end release?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Setup, changeover, release and feedback latency reduction
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Long feedback loops, large economic batches, downtime and costly recovery.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Reduce total safe transition cost, including preparation, validation, recovery and burden transferred across boundaries.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Setup, integration, release or environment preparation materially determines batch size, delay or downtime.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: If setup is rare and immaterial, document the path and avoid an optimisation programme.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: enables smaller batches and flexible capacity. Assumes quality and safety are preserved. Overuse hides transferred work or brittle automation.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Stable interfaces; safe automation; competent maintainers; configuration control; rollback and qualification.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Local setup savings often omit preparation, validation and recovery transferred elsewhere.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: SMED workshops, coloured steps and checklists are optional; lower total transition cost is the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is batch size large because setup, release or feedback is expensive, and has that cost been attacked directly?
Does the metric include validation, recovery and transferred work?
Would automation lower total safe transition cost or merely automate a fragile process?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Demand-capacity pacing and production levelling
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Demand/capacity mismatch, violent mix changes, uneven workloads and hidden overburden.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Level only forecastable aggregate demand, maintain capacity/time buffers and protect workload limits; treat takt as diagnostic, not a metronome.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Repeatable work, measurable aggregate demand, flexible capacity and feasible mix sequencing.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For unique, exploratory or very low-volume work, use finite-capacity planning, rolling forecasts and explicit priority rather than takt ceremony.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: reduces oscillation and overload. Assumes repeatability and demand aggregation. Overuse converts variability into backlog, overtime or supplier stress.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Demand information; cross-trained/flexible resources; setup capability; exception policy; workload and ergonomic safeguards; buffers.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Takt can become a coercive pace standard; conventional levelling has weak applicability in high-mix/low-volume or discovery work.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: Takt boards, heijunka boxes and fixed pitch are manufacturing implementations, not general requirements.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is the work repetitive and demand sufficiently observable for a pace or levelling rule to be meaningful?
Where does residual variation go—capacity reserve, inventory, delay, overtime or suppliers?
Does the mechanism reveal overload or impose an unsafe pace?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Explicit buffer portfolio and strategic slack
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Fragility, starvation, burnout, missed service, recovery delay and hidden risk transfer.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Optimise a portfolio of justified buffers; distinguish protective reserve from accidental queue and continuously reassess assumptions.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Variability or disruption cannot be eliminated economically and service or failure consequences are material.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For low-risk, rapidly recoverable work, keep only a small contingency and explicit recovery path.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Core resilience property. Value: absorbs unavoidable variability. Overuse creates cost/latency; underuse creates fragility.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Demand/failure data; risk appetite; cross-boundary cost visibility; authority to hold reserve; anti-hoarding review.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Classic Lean rhetoric often treats inventory and slack as waste, while disruption and inventory-performance evidence shows non-monotonic returns.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: Safety stock, spare capacity, backup suppliers or time contingencies are implementations. No universal buffer is mandatory.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system explicitly choose among inventory, capacity, time, information and redundancy buffers?
Can it distinguish strategic slack from accidental queueing?
Would proposed WIP or inventory reduction merely transfer risk or workload elsewhere?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Flow and queue-aware capacity over maximum local utilisation
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Congestion, priority churn, long lead time and local output that cannot be absorbed downstream.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Optimise end-to-end service and total buffering cost; treat utilisation as a constraint or signal, not a target to maximise.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Queues grow despite high activity or local productivity gains fail to improve total outcome.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For low variability and ample capacity, simple utilisation monitoring plus exception handling is enough.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: avoids congestion collapse. Assumes a meaningful service boundary. Over-application leaves costly idle capacity; under-application creates nonlinear queues.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Valid system boundary; capacity/arrival data; authority across silos; protected slack; outcome measures.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Lean deployments may still pursue labour or machine utilisation and headcount reduction despite flow doctrine.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: Cell layouts or line-balancing charts are not required; queue-aware admission and capacity rules are alternatives.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target system optimise end-to-end throughput and latency or reward local busy time and output?
Is reserve capacity protected where variability makes high utilisation dangerous?
Are queue costs and the location of the constraint visible?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Demand and replenishment information integrity
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: False demand, bullwhip, duplicate work, priority gaming and long-lead omissions.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: A governed demand-information contract, not blind reaction to the latest request.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Replenishment or release decisions rely on demand signals across time or organisational boundaries.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For direct low-volume requests, use explicit confirmation and a simple backlog.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Value: truthful release and replenishment. Assumes timely signals and response capability. Failure creates starvation, oscillation or false urgency.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Trusted item identity; data quality; latency bounds; incentives that do not reward signal manipulation; long-lead visibility.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: A visible pull signal does not establish trustworthy demand or adequate replenishment capability.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: Physical cards, supermarkets and board movements are optional implementations.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is the demand or pull signal timely, semantically clear and resistant to gaming?
Does the system complement consumption with long-lead, capacity and risk information?
Can urgent exceptions be distinguished from habitual bypass?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Abnormality detection and signalling
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Silent propagation, delayed response and normalisation of deviation.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Detect and signal decision-relevant abnormalities with calibrated severity, accountable response and feedback on false positives/negatives.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Continued operation after an abnormality materially increases harm, rework, delay or uncertainty.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For rare, low-consequence events, use a manual report with clear ownership rather than continuous instrumentation.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Known normal envelope; usable detectors; low-friction human signalling; response ownership; alarm review.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Detection without response creates theatre; automated detection can encode an incomplete model and workers may be punished for signalling.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: An andon cord or light is optional; alerts, checks, guardrails or human escalation can implement the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system expose material abnormalities early enough to change the outcome?
Are detection accuracy, alarm burden and ownership monitored?
Can a person signal safely when automated detection is absent or wrong?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Bounded stop, containment, escalation and recovery authority
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Defect propagation, unsafe continuation and unmanaged emergency escalation.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Severity-calibrated, non-punitive stop/containment authority with response time, restart criteria, evidence preservation and post-event learning.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Expected propagation harm exceeds interruption and recovery cost, or safety/quality boundaries are breached.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For low-consequence reversible anomalies, flag and route to a bounded follow-up queue without stopping the whole system.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Trade-off: containment reduces propagation but interrupts flow. Trigger by severity and expected loss; cheap path is flag-and-follow-up for low consequence.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Psychological/employment safety; available responders; isolation capability; restart authority; false-stop review; recovery path.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: A cord does not confer real authority; line pressure can suppress use, and indiscriminate stopping is costly.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: A physical cord, red light or universal stop is not required; bounded isolation and escalation are the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system give abnormalities a bounded stop, containment or escalation path rather than merely record them?
Who may stop, who must respond, and who may restart?
Does throughput pressure or punishment make the nominal authority unusable?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Quality at source and defect containment
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Downstream rework, defect multiplication, ambiguous ownership and late customer harm.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Use risk-based source verification and containment with independent system-level assurance where local checks cannot see emergent failure.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Defects become more costly or less diagnosable downstream, and source checks have useful sensitivity.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For very low-risk reversible output, use sampled or downstream validation with traceability.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Testability; clear quality criteria; containment path; no incentive to hide defects; qualified repair/release.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Quality at source can become blame at source; inspection does not equal process capability or causal prevention.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: Inspection stamps, quality gates or test suites are implementations; early trustworthy containment is the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Are defects detected and contained before avoidable downstream propagation?
Does a local pass actually establish system quality, or is independent assurance needed?
Can workers report defects without absorbing blame for structural causes?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Mistake-proofing and fail-safe constraints
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Repeatable human error, wrong-part use, omitted steps and unsafe state transitions.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Risk-based constraint or detection for stable error modes, with tested override, monitoring and revision.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Error mode is recurrent, well understood and cheaply preventable or detectable.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: Use a clear cue or checklist for infrequent low-consequence tasks rather than hard constraint.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Accurate error model; escape/override for legitimate exceptions; human-factors testing; maintenance.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: A device can freeze an incorrect process model and shift error elsewhere; not all complex failure has a local mistake.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: A branded poka-yoke device is unnecessary; any verified fail-safe design may implement the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is there a recurrent, well-understood error mode that design can remove or expose?
Does the constraint preserve legitimate exceptions and fail safely?
Would a hard control solve the cause or merely force workarounds?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Jidoka/autonomation: automate routine operation while reserving human exception judgement
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Unattended defect propagation and wasteful human machine-watching.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Automate only stable, testable routine work; make uncertainty and abnormality explicit; preserve human competence and safe fallback.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Routine is stable enough to automate, abnormalities are detectable, and human attention is scarce or high-value.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: Keep manual work where volume is low, judgement dominates or automation cannot fail safely.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Reliable detection; safe state; human response capacity; understandable handoff; maintenance; workload monitoring.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Automation may be justified as labour reduction and can worsen surveillance, pace or job quality; 'human touch' rhetoric is not sufficient.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: Toyota-style machines, andon lights or robots are not required; bounded human-machine allocation is the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Is automation limited to stable routine work with safe exception handoff?
Can humans understand, override and recover the system?
Does the automation reduce harmful work or merely reduce headcount and concentrate cognitive risk?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Process capability, variation measurement and statistical quality control
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Tampering, recurrent defects, false improvement and unstable output.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Use fit-for-purpose variation analysis and capability evidence, explicitly separating stability, customer need and risk.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Repeated measurable output where variation matters and observations are sufficiently comparable.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For rare or unique work, use structured case evidence and direct tests rather than force a control chart.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Measurement-system validity; enough observations; statistical competence; stable definitions; authority to change systemic causes.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Lean accounts sometimes appropriate quality ancestry; Deming did not originate JIT or jidoka, and exact influence on A3/5 Whys is unproven.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: A control-chart poster, Deming Prize programme or Six Sigma belt is not required.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target distinguish signal from routine variation before changing the process?
Are measurements valid and linked to fitness for use rather than merely stable?
Would statistical machinery add value for this population or create false precision?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Explicit current baseline with controlled revision
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Uncontrolled variation, knowledge loss, untestable change and inconsistent training.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: A scoped, versioned, teachable baseline with exceptions, evidence, local challenge rights, qualification, expiry and retirement.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Work recurs, consistency matters, multiple people perform it or failure consequences require a known baseline.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For one-off low-risk work, retain a short decision record or checklist rather than a full standard-work sheet.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Worker input; valid current evidence; change and exception authority; review owner/date; ergonomic and safety assessment.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Labour studies show formalisation can reduce autonomy and wellbeing; Toyota doctrine does not prove democratic control.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: A standard-work sheet is optional. Executable checks, runbooks, contracts or annotated examples can serve.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system distinguish a current baseline from an immutable rule?
Who may deviate, propose revision, qualify the change and retire the standard?
Is the baseline still valid, usable and safe rather than paperwork compliance?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Direct observation combined with traceable system evidence
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Decision by hearsay, dashboard-only management, executive theatre and local anecdotal causation.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Triangulate actual-work observation, system traces, outcome data and stakeholder accounts; label inference and uncertainty.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Material uncertainty exists about what actually happens or reports conflict with outcomes.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For well-instrumented, low-risk routine work, sample direct observation periodically and investigate exceptions.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Access; non-punitive observation; representative sampling; traceability; skill in distinguishing observation from inference.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Direct seeing is neither sufficient nor neutral; distributed software, supply networks and latent harms require instrumentation and testimony.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: A scheduled gemba walk is not required; contextual inquiry, trace review or incident reconstruction may be better.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the system obtain evidence from actual work rather than reports alone?
Is direct observation triangulated with traces, outcomes and affected people's testimony?
Could the observation process distort work or become surveillance?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Evidence-bound problem solving and countermeasure qualification
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Template-driven action, single-root stories, recurrence and false learning.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: A proportional causal-learning loop with competing hypotheses, predictions, safe tests, outcome/side-effect evidence and recurrence review.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: The failure is material, recurrent, causally uncertain or costly enough to justify investigation.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For a trivial one-off reversible issue, fix and record the observation; escalate only on recurrence.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Time and skill; data/provenance; ability to test; independent challenge; authority over causes; follow-up owner.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Format-specific causal evidence is weak; reviews show PDSA often used without core features and RCA often produces weak actions.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: A3 paper, exactly five whys, fishbone or PDCA labels are optional prompts and never evidence.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does repeated failure produce competing causal hypotheses and a qualified countermeasure rather than a completed template?
Are predictions, disconfirming evidence, side effects and recurrence checked?
Would a cheap fix suffice, or is the causal uncertainty consequential enough to trigger the full loop?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Improvement sustainment, expiry, retirement and economics
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Improvement theatre, regression, zombie controls and unbounded process complexity.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Every material improvement is a governed hypothesis with benefit, burden, review, expiry and retirement path.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: A countermeasure changes recurring work or introduces continuing control/maintenance cost.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For ephemeral low-risk changes, define a short observation period and automatic expiry.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Baseline and outcome data; ownership; ability to remove controls; preserved rationale; leadership continuity.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Kaizen-event studies show human outcomes and gains require follow-up; local improvements often lack customer or system outcome evidence.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: Follow-up audits or control plans are implementations; evidence-bearing lifecycle ownership is the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Who owns the improvement after launch, and when is benefit rechecked?
Can obsolete standards, controls and metrics expire or be retired?
Does maintenance cost exceed the current value of the improvement?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Worker capability, training and cross-skilling
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Skill bottlenecks, unsafe improvisation, slow recovery and dependence on a few experts.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Maintain verified capability and cross-coverage for material work, paired with authority, workload protection and fair recognition.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Work recurs, failures require local response, or capacity flexibility depends on transferable skill.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For rare low-risk work, retain accessible guidance and an expert escalation path rather than broad certification.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Paid training time; qualified instructors; humane workload; current baselines; opportunities to practise; recognition of expertise.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Participation and cross-skilling can intensify work and widen responsibility without control, pay or security.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: TWI cards, dojos and skill matrices are optional; demonstrated capability and coverage are the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Do people have trained capability to execute, detect abnormality, recover and improve—not just responsibility?
Is cross-skilling supported by time, pay and staffing rather than used as headcount extraction?
Is competence verified and refreshed when the baseline changes?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Safe voice, participation and bounded change authority
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Suppressed alarms, learned helplessness, management blindness and pseudo-participation.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: A governed rights-and-response system: safe signal, bounded local action, appeal, documented disposition and protection against workload transfer.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Front-line observation is necessary for quality, safety or improvement and management cannot centrally see conditions.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For simple low-risk work, a direct owner contact and documented response is enough.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Employment/psychological safety; response obligation; workload and time; representation; transparent decisions; escalation above local management.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Toyota and Lean rhetoric often labels involvement 'empowerment' while pace, staffing and strategic decisions remain managerial.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: Suggestion boxes, quality circles and daily huddles are optional; real voice and decision rights are the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Can workers safely signal, stop, challenge and propose change, and must the organisation respond?
What decisions are worker-local, team, supervisory, cross-functional or system-owner?
Does participation change decisions or merely supply unpaid improvement labour?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Employment security, trust and fair distribution of productivity gains
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Trust destruction, sabotage, hidden problems, fear-based compliance and 'lean and mean' layoffs.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Before labour-saving improvement, define employment, workload, compensation, redeployment and supplier effects; treat trust as evidence-bearing governance.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Improvement solicits worker knowledge, reduces labour content or changes job design materially.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For small changes with no employment/workload effect, state that boundary and monitor cumulative effects.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Credible management commitment; financial capacity; worker representation/voice; redeployment and training; transparent gain accounting.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Toyota's 1950 dispute and wider Lean layoffs show security is not inherent; national institutions and firm economics matter.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: Respect-for-people slogans, town halls and culture statements do not establish security or fair gains.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Could surfacing or removing work threaten employment, pay, workload or supplier viability?
What credible protections and gain-sharing arrangements make participation rational?
Are labour harms measured alongside flow and cost outcomes?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Management responsibility for system conditions and escalation response
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Blame shifting, repeated local fixes, ignored escalation and transformation decay.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Leaders own the conditions they control, respond to escalations, arbitrate cross-system trade-offs and are measured on outcomes, resilience and worker effects.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: A problem exceeds local authority, recurs across teams or reflects structural operating conditions.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For a bounded local issue, delegate action with a clear escalation threshold.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Authority over resources and policy; transparent response expectations; independent review; outcome and labour measures.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Proponent accounts often make management commitment an unfalsifiable explanation for success or failure.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: Leader standard work, gemba walks and coaching kata are optional; accountable system condition ownership is the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Are repeated local failures traceable to conditions only management or a system owner can change?
Does escalation produce a bounded response and decision?
Are leaders accountable for labour, resilience and incentive side effects, not only throughput?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Whole-system optimisation and proxy/metric governance
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Local optimisation, Goodhart effects, hidden queues, quality sacrifice and worker harm.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Treat metrics as revisable evidence, not targets or truth; pair throughput with quality, outcome, resilience and human effects.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Metrics affect incentives or decisions across interacting components.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For a small team with direct outcome visibility, use a few narrative/quantitative checks rather than a dashboard programme.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Outcome model; stable metric definitions; cross-boundary data; qualitative challenge; no punishment for adverse signals.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Lean measures are frequently used for labour control; DORA and SPACE explicitly warn against single metrics and inappropriate comparisons.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: Obeya boards, SQDC panels, burndowns or DORA dashboards are optional; decision-valid measurement is the property.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Do metrics represent the whole outcome or create a local target that can be gamed?
Are quality, resilience, wellbeing and hidden queues countermeasured?
Can definitions and incentives be revised when behaviour adapts to the metric?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Equipment, service and delivery-system reliability and maintainability
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Unplanned downtime, repeated emergency repair, unsafe degradation and buffer depletion.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Choose maintenance and recovery policy by criticality, failure distribution, consequence and replacement economics.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: Failure interrupts flow materially, has safety/quality consequences or consumes strategic buffers.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CHEAP_PATH: For noncritical, cheap and rapidly replaceable components, use run-to-failure with spares and a tested replacement path.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FLOW_RESILIENCE_PROFILE: Reliability reduces variability and buffer demand. Over-maintenance adds cost; under-maintenance causes disruption. Cheap path is tested run-to-failure for noncritical assets.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_PRECONDITIONS: Criticality model; maintenance windows and capacity; skilled responders; spares; configuration history; feedback from incidents.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.CRITICISMS: Low inventory can convert ordinary failures into crises, while TPM programmes can become checklist bundles without reliability economics.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.ANTI_CEREMONY_BOUNDARY: TPM pillars, maintenance boards and autonomous-maintenance checklists are optional implementations.
QUESTIONS_FOR_REPOSITORY_AUDIT: Does the target identify reliability-critical equipment, services and dependencies?
Is maintenance chosen from failure and recovery economics rather than ritual frequency?
Would reducing buffers expose an unaddressed reliability defect?

TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Supplier and dependency capability development with fair risk allocation
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE: Recurring supplier defects, unstable replenishment, adversarial cost transfer and weak joint learning.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.MATURE_FORM: Develop critical dependency capability only where joint value exceeds coordination and lock-in cost, with explicit fairness and resilience safeguards.
TOP_CROSSWALK_PROPERTIES.TRIGGER: A dependency is recurrent, strategically material and improvable through relationship-specific learning.
